_about: Published accuracy over time, for a talk slide contrasting active (glimpse-based) and passive computer vision. Every value was read on 2026-10-01 in the text of the paper that the url and where fields name (usually the cited paper itself), by PDF text extraction or, where marked, from the PDF's vector figure data; leads that were not confirmed this way are in sota-history.md, not here. kind: active = the model chooses where to look; passive = it sees the whole image. series: overall = passive; for ImageNet, trained with data beyond ImageNet-1k (the overall ImageNet frontier is the running maximum over overall and in1k_only); for ADE20K, any system whose decoder (and usually backbone) is trained on ADE20K, with any pretraining data; in1k_only = passive, ImageNet-1k is the only training data (a teacher trained only on ImageNet-1k is allowed); frozen_ssl = frozen self-supervised backbone with a linear probe; active = sequential glimpses, each chosen after the previous ones; select_once = a policy picks high-resolution patches once from a low-resolution view; borderline = foveated or fixation-based, but not glimpse-limited sensing with a learned policy (see notes). date: first public appearance of this number (arXiv version or venue), YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY when only the year is known; year is its year. value: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC-2012) validation top-1 accuracy in %, or ADE20K (SceneParse150) validation mIoU in %; error rates were converted as 100 - error. protocol (ADE20K only): single-scale, multi-scale, unstated (the paper does not say), linear probe, or linear probe + ms (DINOv2's boosted probe: last 4 layers, 640 px, multi-scale test). Evidence files with the verbatim table lines were kept in the session scratchpad; sota-history.md lists the source of each point.

imagenet_top1.model: DRAM, reimplemented by Elsayed et al. (8 glimpses of 77 px)
imagenet_top1.venue: NeurIPS 2021 (TNet paper), tabulating a NeurIPS 2019 (Saccader) result
imagenet_top1.citation: Papadopoulos, Korus & Memon 2021, Hard-Attention for Scalable Image Classification (DRAM reimplemented by Elsayed, Kornblith & Le 2019; DRAM: Ba, Mnih & Kavukcuoglu 2015)
imagenet_top1.where: Table 1 (#Locs 8), which credits Elsayed et al. 2019
imagenet_top1.notes: Date is the Saccader paper's, which only plots DRAM (Figure 3a); 67.5% at 8 glimpses is the number TNet (2021) and STAM (2022) tabulate from it. ResNet-50 features; Elsayed et al. restricted the classifier's input to the 77 px glimpses. DRAM itself (Ba et al. 2015) was evaluated on digits, not ImageNet.

imagenet_top1.citation: Elsayed, Kornblith & Le 2019, Saccader: Improving Accuracy of Hard Attention Models for Vision
imagenet_top1.notes: ± 0.08 over 5 seeds; 6 glimpses covering 29.47% of the image. Saccader picks locations on a 224 px downsized image; an ImageNet-pretrained NASNet, fine-tuned on the patches, classifies patches cut from the 331 px image. ImageNet-1k only. The base Saccader (BagNet-77-lowD, 224 px, 6 glimpses) is 70.31% as tabulated by TNet.

imagenet_top1.citation: Wang, Lv, Huang, Song, Yang & Huang 2020, Glance and Focus: a Dynamic Approach to Reducing Spatial Redundancy in Image Classification
imagenet_top1.notes: Highest top-1 printed as a number in the paper. A glance at the whole image downsampled to 96 px, then up to 4 focus patches of 96 px from the 224 px image. Encoders initialised from an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50. ImageNet-1k only.

imagenet_top1.notes: Approximate (80.04 by interpolation). Multi-scale patches; about 0.75 GMACs per image. Initialised from an ImageNet-pretrained EfficientNet-B3.

imagenet_top1.citation: Rangrej, Srinidhi & Clark 2022, Consistency driven Sequential Transformers Attention Model for Partially Observable Scenes
imagenet_top1.notes: Average of 10 runs. 224 px images; the agent never sees the full image and senses 27.7K pixels (about 55%). Initialised from a pretrained distilled DeiT-B and trained against a pretrained distilled DeiT-B teacher that sees the whole image (public ImageNet-1k weights). Default DeiT-S agent: 78.25%.

imagenet_top1.model: Liu et al. (learned saccades, 4x4 fovea action space)

imagenet_top1.citation: Mukherjee, Ibrayev & Roy 2024, On Inherent Adversarial Robustness of Active Vision Systems (FALcon: Ibrayev et al. 2023)
